text: In 2021, the property experienced **81.3 hectares of tree-cover loss**, representing **2.23%** of its total area. The loss occurred primarily in **planted forests (68.1 ha)** of *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*, with no native forest affected. An additional **13.2 ha** of loss occurred outside mapped forest areas. The event was corroborated by the **JRC 2020 reference data**, which confirmed **98%** of the area as forest in 2020. Smaller patches (**37.3 ha**) of loss under 0.5 ha were excluded from the total. The loss was consistently detected in both the **2021 and 2025 versions** of the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset.
